# Review instructions for the conciv monorepo

Follow `.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`. It is the single source of truth for how changes in
this repo are reviewed — code laws, SolidJS and TanStack Router idioms, testing rules, security and
architecture boundaries, and the list of things not to flag. Do not duplicate those rules here; add
or change a review rule in that file.
